name: OpenCode + NVIDIA Nemotron + Workbench MCP
description: Code-server IDE with OpenCode, local NVIDIA Nemotron models, Workbench MCP tools, and workspace context. Defaults to Lightning 30B on A100/H100, or experimental Nano 4B on T4/V100. Supports GPU-aware /model switching.
